text:
Priya (new): morning! quick check-in: finished laptop imaging, created GCP service account, but hitting two blockers: can't SSH into jump host (Permission denied) and my Yubikey GPG not recognized on macOS. What I did: followed onboarding docs, raised helpdesk ticket IT-789. Blockers: SSH + yubikey. Today: need access to model-registry and CI runner. @Devon any tips? @samir can you recheck jump-host ACLs? thanks!
Devon: hi! re: SSH, can you paste `ssh -vvv jump` output? often it's agent forwarding. Also check `~/.ssh/config` for ProxyCommand. For Yubikey: on mac, needs pinentry-mac + gpg 2.3; if you installed via homebrew you might need to relink. I can jump on a quick call at 11:30 if that helps.
samir: I looked at the ACLs — your user isn't in group "jump-access" yet. Rosa submitted the IAM invite, but IT flagged missing MFA registration. I'll add you manually in the meantime.
onboarding-bot: Created support ticket IT-790 to add priya to jump-access. ETA ~3h. Pinged infra.
Priya (new): attaching ssh -vvv output I ran:
```ssh -vvv -o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p jump" priya@redwood
OpenSSH_8.3p1, LibreSSL 2.8.3
debug1: Offering public key: /Users/priya/.ssh/id_ed25519
debug1: Authentications that can continue: publickey
debug1: No more authentication methods available.
Permission denied (publickey).
```
Devon: try `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (mac keychain) or run `GPG_TTY=$(tty) gpg --card-status` and `gpg-connect-agent updatestartuptty /bye` for yubikey. If still broken, drop into #eng-infra and we can escalate.
Rosa: added priya to jump-access and confirmed with IT. You should be able to SSH now — try `ssh jump` then `ssh -A arron@internal-host`.
Priya (new): works! :tada: yubikey fixed after reinstalling pinentry-mac and running `gpg --card-status`. One small remaining issue: can't push to model-registry repo due to LFS auth error.
samir: gave you write on the repo. Run `git lfs install --force` and re-auth; check https://git.internal/teams/model-registry for the invite link.
Priya (new): accepted invite, pushed test branch and CI kicked off. Today's plan: pair with Devon on runtime onboarding at 14:00, finish first infra PR for housekeeping, and follow up on remaining docs. Thanks everyone :heart:
Devon: great, see you at 14:00. Welcome aboard!
Rosa: welcome Priya! If anything pops up after pairing ping me directly.
